decisions.decision: Classify an XRP address as Binance PoR only after exact matching against the official dated address export; provider labels and the Binance 14 ETH finding are not substitutes.
decisions.reason: Five XRPL source accounts are Binance-labelled, but the confirmed PoR article finding is Ethereum-only and the official address export was not retrieved.

decisions.decision: Keep Binance ETH, USDT and XRP reserve coverage as separate asset-level observations; never infer an XRP reserve shortfall from the reported ETH shortfall.
decisions.reason: CoinDesk's approximately 94% estimate is specific to ETH after the reported Binance 14/16 drain.

decisions.decision: Do not average Alpha Finance and Liqwall XRP OI; retain provider, cutoff, venue, contract universe and notional basis separately.
decisions.reason: USD2.83B and USD1.30B observations differ materially and are not harmonized.

decisions.decision: Treat ETF flow as issuer-holdings change with per-fund coverage, exclusions, reconstructed intervals and BITW/ETF-of-ETF treatment; do not equate with direct same-window spot buys.
decisions.reason: XRP Insights documents excluded and reconstructed rows and different fund structures.

decisions.decision: Preserve event chronology; Oct29 ETF session close at 20:00 UTC precedes first identified XRP drain at 20:05 UTC, so completed session flows are not incident-response flows.
decisions.reason: Temporal ordering rules out a post-transfer response for the completed session absent separate prior-information evidence.

decisions.decision: Keep new derivatives, ETF and incident observations out of predictive features until source coverage, timestamps, point-in-time labels and historical continuity are reconciled; maintain NOT_ISSUED.
decisions.reason: Provider OI divergence, holdings-derived flows and unrefreshed receiver status do not support calibrated directional forecasting.

decisions.decision: PR #1379 is a verified fresh-main proposal, not an active main fix; scheduled main writers remain until authorized merge.
decisions.reason: Exact-head core CI and gate passed, but PR remains draft/unmerged and main was not modified.
